retrievalProfile.description: A split-tone vertical background featuring a dynamic male figure in mid-air and a poised female figure in formal wear, topped with heavy italicized display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio composition where a male in a black tuxedo is captured in a playful, jumping mid-air pose against a grey/white gradient, while a female in a white formal gown stands elegantly against a blue/white gradient. The two halves are divided by a sharp vertical line, unified by a bold, black, italicized title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical split dividing the canvas into two distinct color zones
Contrast between the dynamic, airborne male and the static, elegant female
Top-heavy title anchoring the two disparate halves
Color-coded backgrounds reflecting the subjects' attire (black/white vs. white/blue)
coreInvariants: Sharp vertical division of the background
High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupying the middle 70% of the frame; male on the left, female on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold black title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the title, follows the male's diagonal jumping motion down to the left, then sweeps right to the standing female figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and around the feet to emphasize the split background effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral white and grey on the left half.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue gradient on the right half.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Solid black for the tuxedo and primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) backgrounds with high contrast subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'N' have sharp, aggressive angles
Circular 'O's are slightly compressed by the slant
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy display title with small, light serif metadata in the corners for a classic 80s print look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and clean geometric structure.
Captures the geometric 80s feel and sharp angles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a studio shot with a vertical split: the left side is a light grey to white gradient, the right side is a light blue to white gradient. Place a man in a black tuxedo jumping playfully on the left and a woman in a white gown standing elegantly on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, black, italicized sans-serif title across the top center. Add small serif text in the bottom corners for technical credits.

verificationChecks: Is the title extremely bold and slanted?
Is there a clear vertical line dividing the two background colors?
Are the subjects in formal evening wear?
Is the male subject in a dynamic, mid-air pose?

adjustableVariables: Background color on the right (can change from blue to pink or gold)
Subject poses (can vary as long as one is dynamic and one is static)
mustRedesign: Do not use the exact 'Moonlighting' logo
Ensure the split background is a clean graphic element, not a physical wall
postGenerationChecks: Check that the title is centered over the split.
Ensure the male figure's feet are off the ground.
Verify the gown is white and the tuxedo is black.
Confirm the background gradients are smooth.
Check that the typography does not have a drop shadow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Dynamic Subject] + [Static Subject] + [Vertical Split Background] + [Heavy Italic Sans-Serif Header] to recreate this 80s promotional aesthetic.
